evidence.title: Dia | The browser for better days at work.

name: Dia
summary: Desktop browser with AI chat that reads across your tabs and tools, plus profiles, split view and meeting features.
description: Dia is a browser for macOS and Windows with a built-in AI layer: ask questions on any page, get synthesis from connected tools (Slack, Notion, Teams, GSuite), and turn scattered context into reports or slides. Free browser tier; Better Answers ($10/month) and Better Days ($100/month) plans add AI usage, the daily Morning Brief and meeting prep.
contains: free browser tier; Better Answers $10/month; Better Days $100/month
AI chat over tabs and connected tools (Slack, Notion, Teams, GSuite, GitHub)
profiles, tab groups, split view, picture-in-picture, ad and tracking blocker, cross-device sync
Morning Brief daily summary plus reports, decks and meeting prep on paid plans
Early Birds program for early access to experimental features
